turns.text: Hello, I received a print last week but the colors do not match my room. I would like to return it.
I'm sorry the colors don't suit your room. I can help with a return. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, so I can verify it.
My order is SC-4060 and the email used is liam.fletcher.v2@example.com. Please file the return request.
I've filed your return request for order SC-4060. Staff must approve it, and the refund too. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and you pay the return postage.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: Separate question. How many working days does print production usually take?
Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.

rule.ro: Fiecare print este realizat la comandă în 3–5 zile lucrătoare.
rule.en: Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.

turns.text: Revin la printul meu. Cine plateste transportul pentru retur?
Clientul plătește transportul retur. Cererea ta de retur pentru comanda SC-4060 așteaptă aprobarea echipei, care aprobă și rambursarea.
I still want to return order SC-4060. I can cover the return shipping.

Thanks for confirming that you'll pay the return shipping. Your return request R-1 for order SC-4060 is already filed, so I haven't filed a second one. Staff still have to approve it. I've passed your case to a colleague, who will take over from here.

input.summary: Customer confirmed again they want to return SC-4060 (colors don't match room) and will pay return shipping. Return request R-1 already filed and pending staff approval. No new request filed.
